description: Pull request titles follow Conventional Commits (the PR title check and release-please rely on it). pnpm refuses versions younger than a day, hence minimumReleaseAge.

packageRules.description: Workflow actions: ci(deps), one grouped pull request.
Development dependencies: chore(deps), grouped unless major.
Runtime dependencies reach every consumer: fix(deps), so they ship in a patch release.
Non-major updates merge themselves once every required check passes; Renovate bypasses only the code owner review (.github/rulesets/main-reviews.json).
0.x minor versions may break: review them.
Pinning to a commit SHA keeps the same version: merge it right away.
